children.text: Lindsay Nikole is an influencer who focuses on zoology and paleontology videos. Her videos (specifically her YouTube content, as that is what is being analyzed) maintain a balance between a conversational tone that relies on humor and casual terminology and well-studied science. This content is often referred to as “edutainment.” In her videos, she presents herself using casual conventions rather than as a traditional lecturer or documentary narrator.
